15. Please write a paragraph detailing your skills and experience that would make you a good fit for this position, and why you want to work for the Pleasant Valley School District.

16. By typing your name below, you certify that all of your statements in this supplemental application are true and complete to the best of your knowledge, and that if you have made any false statements, you may be disqualified or dismissed from employment.
Maintain District standards of excellent customer service and professional behavior in various and sometimes challenging situations.
Access and monitor District email daily to receive important updates from school and District administration.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.

Perform a variety of general and routine clerical duties; type letters, memoranda, bulletins, reports, requisitions, or other materials from detailed or rough copy; proofread completed typing assignments.
Receive visitors; answer telephone and refer calls and visitors to appropriate personnel; answer routine questions according to established guidelines.

Serve as a liaison between teachers, parents, students, support staff and the community regarding educational programs, services and various student issues; assists in coordinating and arranging various programs and services to meet the needs of students and encourages parent involvement in all school-related activities.

Meet, confer with, and interviews parents in the identification of family needs and issues; provides information and materials to parents to assist in the location and utilization of school and community services and resources; refers parents to school services or community resources as appropriate.

Translate communication between teachers, staff and limited or non-English speaking students and parents as assigned by the position; serves as an interpreter for conferences, telephone calls, assemblies and meetings; translates written correspondence as necessary.

Composes, distributes and responds to a variety of correspondence related to assigned liaison and support services; initiates and receives telephone calls; schedules and arranges various student, parent and other appointments.
Arranges, schedules and requests parent participation in conferences, meetings and other activities; encourages parent participation in various school and community programs and services.
Attends and participates in various meetings as assigned.
Maintain professional standards; ensure student and District confidentiality.
Operate a variety of standard office equipment.
Sort and file material according to established procedures; maintain records, logs, inventories, and routine files.
Distribute and receive a variety of records, reports and bulletins as directed.
